generate-artwork.note: Imported cosmic dark is the new-cover default; UI and album themes are independent. No publication approval is inferred.

custom-voice.note: Private model import and explicit original-passage audition; no automatic voice replacement or model publication.

record-dataset.note: Record the original prompts locally. Training remains unsupported until an adapter actually produces and verifies a model.

add-function.note: Wizard creates a record. Author actual narration and explicit bindings before planning; never fabricate missing narration.

review-narration.note: Preserve protected wording, provenance and canonical commands; record human review separately.

add-locale.note: Replace en-US with the authored locale. Spoken fallback stays strict.

plan-all.note: No synthesis; generated source plans inherit the shared configuration.

render-audition.note: Real rendering requires explicit start. Review timing reports and listen before approval.

debug-render.note: Inspect retained job logs and scratch; never silently rerun an expensive failed job.

package-release.note: Select a registered implementation and explicit approved PNG/JPEG artwork. Use --dry-run first; packaging success is not rights clearance.

validate-pr.note: Run focused tests while editing, then make check, make lint and the full pytest suite before completion.
